 Sudurpaschim Royals to bowl first against Chitwan Rhinos 
 Nepal News 
 November 2, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Sudurpaschim Royals have opted to bowl first after winning the toss against Chitwan Rhinos in the second match of the Nepal Premier League (NPL) on Monday.
 The toss took place at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, where Sudurpaschim captain Dipendra Singh Airee made the decision to field.
